meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: Claude 会把代码库按功能拆成 Mermaid 流程图,找出跨功能的重复逻辑,提出统一架构方案,并在仓库生成 PATHFINDER-日期 文件夹,内含功能清单、流程图、重复报告、统一提案和可直接粘贴的 /make-plan 提示词。它只出图和计划,不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说「find the ideal path」、要统一重复的系统,或在重构前审查架构时触发。流程从功能发现开始,先确认功能边界再展开。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 把 src/ 按功能画成流程图。
say.note: 会先生成功能清单并等你确认边界。

say.text: 找出这些功能里重复的队列实现,提个统一方案。
say.note: 输出重复报告和统一提案。

say.text: 给统一后的每个系统生成 /make-plan 提示词。

howto.what_en: Claude maps the codebase into Mermaid flowcharts by feature, finds duplicated concerns, and proposes a unified architecture. It writes a PATHFINDER-<date>/ folder with flowcharts, a duplication report and /make-plan prompts. No code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. It starts with feature discovery and confirms feature boundaries before fanning out.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder to map src/ into flowcharts by feature.
say_en.note: It writes a feature inventory first and waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Find the duplicated queue code across these features and propose one unified design.
say_en.note: Outputs a duplication report plus unified proposal.

say_en.text: Write /make-plan handoff prompts for each unified system.
